resources.string: Wireless ADB guardian — passive watchpost + active shield
On boot, deploy the guard and enable wireless ADB automatically.

ADBLive keeps wireless ADB alive on your device. It combines two layers: Passive Guard only needs root and auto-restarts adbd if it dies, while Active Shield requires the LSPosed framework to block the system from stopping wireless ADB. The ADB port is fixed at 5555. To enable Active Shield: open LSPosed, enable ADBLive, and select System Framework (system) and com.android.settings (ADBLive\'s own app is auto-injected), then reboot.
Needs LSPosed: select system + com.android.settings in scope (own app is auto-injected), then reboot. Blocks the system from disabling wireless ADB or killing adbd.
Shows whether root is currently granted to this app.
Only needs root; a background process restarts adbd if it is killed.
Turn wireless ADB on/off. The listening port is fixed at 5555.
